Services

Cuts and shaves, the traditional way

The services the shop publishes, done walk-in. Tap one to see what it covers.

Regular cuts and styles for men, women, and children, cut the way you ask for them.
The shop's own headline service: a traditional straight-razor shave, the reason the sign says Shaving Parlor.
An all-scissor cut for longer styles and finer control.
A clean, even clipper cut, as short as you want it.
Edges and lines cleaned up between full cuts.

The Shop

A house, a porch, and a barber pole

Ron's is a house-style shop on Fishburn Rd with a waiting porch out front and a room full of barbering history inside.

Walk-ins only

No appointments. That is the point.

Ron's runs the way barber shops used to: you walk in, you get in line, you get cut. The shop's own directory profile headlines it plainly, "Ron's Barber Shop is a Walk-In Barbershop!", and regulars say the same: no appointments, walk in.

While you wait, there is the porch: wicker chairs and a rocking chair under the barber pole. Inside, it is black leather chairs, dark-wood stations, and a display of vintage barbering gear the shop keeps for the love of the trade. Cuts are for men, women, and children, and families are welcomed by name in the shop's own description.
